name: canonical-data-and-collection-cli
plain_language_goal: 交付可执行的数据规格、可追溯的400条基础数据，以及用一条管线完成采集到发布的非交互式CLI。

files.mutation_rule: frozen; contract 3.5.0 does not change G1/G2 baseline source identity, normalized data bytes, or evidence
frozen; normal_source_pair remains ydniu plus eastmoney for the accepted baseline
fail closed on missing file, hash mismatch, schema mismatch, expired review, or production/redistribution approval other than false

configuration_inputs.validation_rule: Preflight hashes every applicable configuration input before creating a request plan. The acceptance report records path and observed SHA-256; a mismatch makes the product CLI/preflight exit 4 and creates no request, run, or release. E2E-05 records underlying_exit_code=4, classifies HOLD, and makes the acceptance runner exit 20.

acceptance_exit_mapping.rule: Never report product CLI exit 4 as the acceptance runner exit. Preserve it as underlying_exit_code while the E2E-05 or G3 runner returns 20 for HOLD.

live_execution_profile.scope: incremental:live only; snapshot/replay baseline schemas, the six frozen v1 schemas, G1 bundle, and G1/G2 normalized data bytes remain byte-identical
live_execution_profile.manifest_rule: RunManifest v1.3 is persisted exactly once through write_once_json and is never overwritten or mutated. request_plan is exactly four ordered static GET history requests: live-ydniu-ssq-history, live-swlc-ssq-history, live-ydniu-dlt-history, live-gdlottery-dlt-history. Dynamic discovery, request_discovered, child_authorization, announcement requests, input_ref, guessed issue URLs, and any fifth logical request are forbidden.

gd_history_request.query_rule: exact queryless URL; cache-busters and all query strings are forbidden
gd_history_request.cap_rule: The 2 MiB cap applies only to this exact GD JSON endpoint; every other current live request remains capped at 1048576 bytes (1 MiB).

gd_history_fixture.validation_rule: All top-level identity keys are strict; every 085 record, including older records outside latest20, is fully validated. Non-085 record bodies are not interpreted as DLT records.

live_execution_profile.effective_plan_rule: The effective plan is exactly the four manifest requests. Each logical request has one or two consecutive audited attempts; every request_started attempt has exactly one request_succeeded or request_failed terminal. published/no_change requires all four logical requests to succeed, while request_stats count logical requests rather than attempts.
live_execution_profile.event_stream_rule: RunEvent v1.3 forbids request_discovered. The validator enforces explicit v1.3 manifest/event identity, contiguous sequence/event IDs, request identity against the four static plan entries, consecutive attempt numbers 1..2, one terminal per started attempt, at most one final run terminal, and no event after the terminal.
live_execution_profile.terminal_result_rule: Every run_published, run_no_change, run_rejected or run_interrupted terminal requires exactly one RunResult; RunResult is forbidden before a run terminal. published/no_change use exit 0, rejected uses non-zero, interrupted recovery may use null; release_id is non-null only for published. RunResult request_stats must exactly match the validated four-request event stream.
live_execution_profile.raw_artifact_rule: Every live request_succeeded artifact_ref is content-addressed as raw/<source>/<game>/sha256/<sha256>.raw. The raw file is durably persisted and its file SHA-256 equals both the path digest and parse provenance before parser entry.
live_execution_profile.preflight_failure_output: Policy/hash/schema/expiry failure before run creation emits only a non-persistent preflight envelope, creates no request, run, or release, and invents no manifest/events/quality artifact reference. E2E-05 preserves underlying exit 4, classifies HOLD, and the acceptance runner exits 20.
live_execution_profile.dual_profile_rule: verify, recovery, and replay dispatch only from the explicit manifest schema version plus the matching frozen policy SHA. Current v1.3, historical v1.2, and legacy v1.1 are disjoint; request shape or legacy fields must never select or upgrade a profile.

legacy_compatibility.rule: These bytes are immutable historical compatibility fixtures only. They do not authorize current live collection and are never interpreted as current policy 1.3.0.

live_execution_profile.replay_read_rule: Replay remains read_only_without_lock. It freezes and hashes manifest/raw inventory before processing, performs no network or publication operation, then re-inventories and re-hashes before acceptance. Any concurrent addition, removal, or byte change exits 5 and publishes nothing.

live_recheck_contract.window_rule: For each game, form the latest-20 window over the union of current and newly observed issue keys. Every newly observed issue is a target; existing issues are recheck targets only when they fall inside that window and have at least one current-run observation.
live_recheck_contract.new_issue_rule: Any observation makes a new issue a target. The required two-source pair must be complete and from distinct publishers; otherwise the issue is unresolved and publication is rejected.
live_recheck_contract.complete_existing_rule: An existing recheck target with the complete required pair follows normal unchanged, revised, or conflict handling. Any extra observation that dissents from the complete pair blocks publication.
live_recheck_contract.deferred_existing_rule: If an existing recheck target lacks its required partner and every available observation core equals the current DrawRecord core, retain the old draw and old evidence, record reconciliation reason RECHECK_DEFERRED_MISSING_PARTNER, increment recheck_deferred, do not increment unresolved, do not block publication, and do not count or describe that recheck as complete.
live_recheck_contract.unconfirmed_change_rule: If an existing recheck target lacks its required partner and any available observation core differs from the current DrawRecord core, record RECHECK_UNCONFIRMED_CHANGE, increment unresolved, and reject publication without revising the draw.
live_recheck_contract.gap_rule: The existing bounded same-year internal-gap rule remains unchanged.
live_recheck_contract.observed_gd_limit: The approved queryless GD history JSON fixture is 1,828,447 bytes with 14,091 top-level records and 1,276 strict 085 identities. It deterministically supplies latest20 2026067..2026086, including the 26084..26086 closure. One observed response does not establish a long-term publication-time SLA.
live_recheck_contract.source_scope_rule: Keep ydniu+swlc for live SSQ and ydniu+gdlottery for live DLT. Do not add portals whose collection and redistribution review is incomplete.
live_recheck_contract.current_execution_profile: RunManifest/RunEvent v1.3 uses exactly four static history requests, at most two audited attempts per logical request, and forbids discovery or child requests. Historical v1.2 and legacy v1.1 profiles remain byte-frozen only for compatibility.

object_contract.request_event_rule: request_started is appended and flushed before every network attempt; exactly one request_succeeded or request_failed closes that same attempt; attempt 2 is permitted only after a retryable attempt-1 failure

collection_policy_contract.candidate_rule: every observed new issue plus every observed existing issue inside the per-game latest-20 union window; incomplete existing pairs follow the explicit deferred/unconfirmed-change rules
collection_policy_contract.unobserved_schedule_rule: do not infer an issue solely from the draw calendar
collection_policy_contract.internal_gap_rule: a same-year numerical gap bounded by observed newer and older issues is unresolved until explained
collection_policy_contract.agreement_rule: two different publishers must agree on core_fact_sha256
collection_policy_contract.source_pair_publisher_rule: the two selected source ids must map to different publisher ids
collection_policy_contract.additional_observation_rule: retain agreeing extras in run reconciliation but not the release evidence set; any dissent blocks publication
collection_policy_contract.fallback_rule: only an explicitly approved source-catalog entry may be used
collection_policy_contract.known_limit: correction checks target the per-game latest-20 union window. The approved queryless GD history JSON contains 1,276 strict 085 records and deterministically supplies latest20 through 2026086; incomplete required pairs remain explicitly deferred and are never reported complete
collection_policy_contract.phase1_source_review_scope: internal research collection only; production service and redistribution require a separate review
collection_policy_contract.mode_specific_policy_rule: Snapshot bootstrap and snapshot incremental use the frozen collection-policy.json. Live incremental uses live-source-policy.json and its per-game pairs. No live setting may reinterpret or replace accepted baseline evidence.
collection_policy_contract.live_review_expiry_rule: If the acceptance date is later than live-source-policy.valid_until, product CLI/preflight exits 4 without creating a request, run, or release. E2E-05 and G3 report HOLD with underlying_exit_code=4 and the acceptance runner exits 20; dates must never be extended automatically.

exit_codes.2: parse, response-schema, data-quality or source-conflict failure
exit_codes.4: argument, configuration, schema-definition or source-policy failure
exit_codes.6: publish lock contention or current-release compare-and-swap failure

publication_contract.precondition: current previous_release_id must equal the value captured by preflight
publication_contract.release_write: same-filesystem temporary directory followed by verified rename
publication_contract.pointer_write: temporary file followed by atomic replace
publication_contract.failure_effect: preserve run evidence; do not create release or modify current-release.json
publication_contract.recovery_effect: append request_failed recovery events for started requests without a terminal event, mark the stale run interrupted, and move the temporary release into its recovery evidence directory
publication_contract.replay_stable_read: Capture and hash the complete manifest/raw inventory before replay; after deterministic processing, re-inventory and re-hash. Any concurrent change exits 5. Replay never acquires the publish lock, uses network, creates a release, or changes current-release.json.

implementation_sequence: implement W3 bootstrap kernel through atomic publication
use the W3 bootstrap kernel to produce and accept W2
complete W3 incremental, replay, verify, concurrency and recovery on the same pipeline
obtain a current live-source smoke PASS

fault_exit_map.forced_process_termination: no normal exit; recovered as interrupted on next start

gates.pass_rule: all verification commands and assertions PASS
G1 PASS and all verification commands, assertions and evidence checks PASS
G1 and G2 PASS; every deterministic check PASS; current live smoke PASS; both reviews have zero blocking findings

final_acceptance.contract_resign_rule: Contract 3.5.0 freezes live policy 1.3.0 with at most two audited attempts per static request. G1/G2 normalized data, baseline IDs, and artifact bytes remain unchanged, but formal G1/G2/G3/ALL reports must be re-signed before this contract is claimed as accepted.
final_acceptance.go_rule: all required deliverables exist; G1, G2 and G3 are PASS; required evidence hashes verify; no blocking review finding exists
final_acceptance.hold_rule: any required evidence is missing, any assertion fails, the current live smoke is not PASS, or a blocking review finding exists
